Title: Werke des Patriarchen von Bulgarien Euthymius (1375-1393), nach den besten Handschriften herausgegeben von Emil Kaluzniacki
Creator: Euthymius of Tarnovo; edited by Emil Kaluzniacki (title page, read on the page image, leaf n7)
Publisher: Wien: in Commission bei Carl Gerold's Sohn (title page, read on the page image)
Publication Date: 1901 (title page; OCR lines 130 and 173, and the page image, leaf n7)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1901); the archive.org record is tagged NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT
Language: chu
Source: archive.org item werkedespatriar00kagoog, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,841,128) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1901, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the scan was read with a Cyrillic model. The Church Slavonic texts are in real Cyrillic and can be followed, with letter confusions and split digraphs. The German introduction, notes and running heads are turned into Cyrillic look-alike letters and cannot be read; the title page stands in look-alike letters, with the year 1901 legible. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Euthymius's Lives, encomia, letters and liturgical works in Church Slavonic, with a German introduction. His Life of Hilarion of Moglena from OCR line 6946 (heading at 6949-6956) to 8385, in eighteen chapters; the Life of Paraskeve (Petka) follows from about 8396. The other works were not mapped. Gregory Tsamblak's Praise of Euthymius is not in this volume.
